# Subway Seat for Terminator

Palette, cursor and the title bar colors for the focused, broadcast-receiving and inactive terminals. Paste the snippet under the existing `[profiles]` heading. Terminator doesn't follow the system light/dark setting, so pick one flavor.

[Terminator](https://gnome-terminator.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/terminator/) · Needs Terminator 2.1.2+

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.config`](subway-seat.config) | Paste under [profiles] in ~/.config/terminator/config |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.config`](subway-seat-tunnel.config) | Paste under [profiles] in ~/.config/terminator/config |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.config`](subway-seat-enamel.config) | Paste under [profiles] in ~/.config/terminator/config |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in right-click › Profiles, or from a shell:

```sh
terminator -p "Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in right-click › Profiles, or from a shell:

```sh
terminator -p "Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in right-click › Profiles, or from a shell:

```sh
terminator -p "Subway Seat Enamel"
```

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
